SalesRepToken.privacy: non-customer employee/synthetic rep display token already authorized by the owning source field; @, controls, line breaks, email, phone and customer-derived content forbidden

StableSourceLineId.privacy: order-local operational identifier; no customer-derived content

TimestampOrDate.date_branch: exact Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD with no T/offset
TimestampOrDate.disjointness: a lexeme matches exactly one branch or rejects

equality: same specialization plus byte-identical RFC8785 wrapper
explicit_null_rule: All four members are always serialized; omission is invalid.
hash: For each wrapper row, SHA256(UTF8("doi-observed-value/r01-v2/" + exact canonical field path + "\n") || UTF8(RFC8785(wrapper))).
invalid_cross_partitions: UNKNOWN with non-null value or missing/wrong reason
legacy_line_hint_map: The independent v1 privacy_safe_raw_hints map is not writable in the replacement line schema. The integrated doi-line-item-snapshot/v2 removes it; a compatibility view may derive the same field→symbolic-code projection from wrappers but never hashes or persists a second copy.

KNOWN.value: required and non-null, exact field specialization

UNKNOWN.reason_code: required exact field row from R01_UNKNOWN_REASON_MATRIX.json

quantity_failure_precedence: A parsed numeric outside the final Quantity domain fails construction and is never represented by RC-128..RC-131. Those reasons remain for readable opaque/uninterpretable source facts only.

raw_hint_rules.all_other_fields: raw_hint must be null, including every rep/geography/payment/quantity/money/product/finding and alternate-observation field
raw_hint_rules.invalid_behavior: Reject the hint before persistence; retain no rejected bytes and return only the field normalization reason.
raw_hint_rules.representation: null or one exact RawHintCode JSON string; copied source text and extension objects are forbidden
raw_hint_rules.source_locus_gate: A code may be selected only from the matching field allowlist after a source-locus privacy gate. The source lexeme is never copied.
